title: Jackson Hole 2026 Symposium Opens; Markets Await Fed Chair Warsh's First Keynote on Rate Policy
summary: The Kansas City Fed's annual Jackson Hole Economic Symposium opened Aug 27 (through Aug 29), with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh scheduled to deliver his first keynote address on Aug 28 at 10:00 ET. Markets are pricing ~40% odds of a September rate hike after July's 9-3 FOMC split (Cleveland/Minneapolis/Dallas dissented for hike). Current Fed funds rate: 3.50-3.75%; core PCE at 3.3%, above the 2% target. Theme: 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.'
why: Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote is the highest-profile near-term catalyst for US rate path and global risk assets. A hawkish tilt would reprice September hike odds and pressure rate-sensitive positions across HK/US portfolios.

title: Gold hits over 3-month high of $4,677/oz on dollar weakness and Treasury buyback plans
summary: Spot gold reached $4,677-4,700/oz on Aug 25, its highest level since mid-May 2026, driven by USD weakness and US Treasury bond buyback expectations. Gold is up 15%+ in August alone; UOB noted this is on track for the strongest monthly gain since September 1999. Both CNBC and Bloomberg confirmed the move independently. The rally builds on the existing item about Treasury buybacks and gold at $4,480 (Aug 19) already in data.json.
why: Gold at 3-month highs is relevant to 老铺黄金 (6181.HK) and broader macro positioning. Sustained dollar weakness and fiscal policy signals (Treasury buybacks) are driving the repricing of real assets.
